name: phygital-plus-openai
description: Phygital+ generation models for ChatGPT: one tool per model with its own input schema - images, video, audio, 3D and text - plus job status, cancel and file upload.

interface.longDescription: Runs Phygital+ generative models from ChatGPT: each model is its own tool with its own input schema - create and edit images, generate video, music and speech, upscale, remove backgrounds, build 3D models. Every run happens on your Phygital+ account and spends its credits; results come back as links to your files.
defaultPrompt: Create a product photo with Phygital+ FLUX.
Write three perfume taglines using Phygital+ GPT Text.

review.commerce_description: Users purchase subscriptions and generation credits on the Phygital+ website. Generations consume credits from the connected Phygital+ account. Payment takes place on the Phygital+ website.

positive.description: Generate an image with FLUX. Setup: dedicated connected test account with access to this model and sufficient credits. No attachment required.
positive.prompt: Use Phygital+ FLUX to create a product photo of a purple glass perfume bottle on a white background.
positive.tools_triggered: generate_image_flux; get_job only when no tracking panel is active or the user requests status.
positive.expected_behavior: Call generate_image_flux once with schema-valid arguments expressing a purple glass perfume bottle on a white background. Preserve the returned job_id. Track that same job until terminal status. On completion return the image result supported by the actual tool response; never invent output URLs or report completion while pending. If authentication, balance, or model availability prevents completion, report the actual error; the successful workflow remains unverified.

negative.description: Account deletion is unsupported. Explain the limitation and direct the user to Phygital+ support. Do not invoke generation, upload, or cancellation tools, and do not claim deletion.

negative.description: Billing changes are unsupported by these MCP tools. Explain how to manage billing on the Phygital+ website without calling tools or claiming a charge.

negative.description: Generation-history listing is unsupported. Explain that a known job_id is needed; do not invent identifiers or invoke tools to search for history.
